title: test(scripts): stop pinning a pending changeset filename in the two gate suites
body:
Part of #9472 — the Q2-A half only.

⛔ **Deliberately not a closing keyword, and that is a declared deviation from my dispatch** (which asked for one). The director's ruling (comment `5682619925`) states this card's closing condition as **three** terms: this lane's repair, objectui#9569, and the scheduled `Changeset Release` lane reading green on a run **after both**. Merging this pull request satisfies exactly one of the three, so a closing keyword would shut the card before the lane reading that the ruling makes the point of it. The half left open is the lane reading. objectui#9569 is verified landed — merged `2026-09-16T00:55:43Z` as `f7fcc2cdb`, which is this branch's base — and at the time of writing no scheduled run has fired since.

## The defect, in one sentence

`scripts/markdown-test-inputs.mjs` resolves markdown path literals out of every test's source and offers only the ones that **exist in the tree**; two suites named a **pending** changeset by filename, and `pnpm changeset:version` deletes exactly those files.

So on the post-version tree the scanner stopped offering them, the ledger entries that declared them turned into `stale-not-read` findings, and `Validate the post-version tree` went red.

| suite | the literal it named | is it a real pending declaration? |
|:--|:--|:--|
| `check-changeset-overwrite.test.ts` | `.changeset/olive-donkeys-smile.md` | yes |
| `check-installed-spec-pin-claims.test.ts` | `.changeset/8897-installed-spec-pin-claims.md` | yes |

## What changed

- **`check-changeset-overwrite.test.ts`** hoists its peer release declaration into a `PEER_CHANGESET` constant. The fixture repository writes that file itself, as it always did; only the name is now the test's own. The `fixture-` prefix belongs to neither namespace a committed name can come from — `pnpm changeset` generates `adjective-animal-verb`, and this repository commits an issue-number-and-slug name — so it cannot become a pending declaration. The generated-name tail is kept so the fixture still wears the shape the objectui#6336 hazard wears.
- **`check-installed-spec-pin-claims.test.ts`** hands `isScanned` a synthetic name. That exclusion is by **path prefix** (`.changeset/`), so the basename carried no meaning in the assertion to begin with.
- **`scripts/markdown-test-inputs.mjs`** drops the two ledger `notRead` entries that described the old literals. This is a **surface addition** over my claim comment's declared file set, and it is not optional: leave those entries and the scanner reds on the tree as it stands, because the literals they describe are gone.

## Both directions, measured

The version step's effect on these two files is that it consumes them, so the probe consumes them. Every leg proved its mutation landed on disk (both paths absent) and proved its restore by `git hash-object` equality against the `HEAD` blob, never by an exit code.

| leg | tree | command | result |
|:--|:--|:--|:--|
| control | pristine base, files present | `vitest run scripts/__tests__/markdown-test-inputs.test.ts` | **exit 0**, 24 passed |
| defect | base, both changesets consumed | same | **exit 1** — `AssertionError: expected [ …(2) ] to deeply equal []`, two `stale-not-read` findings, matching the lane's annotation |
| fixed | this branch, files present | the three affected suites | **exit 0**, 74 passed |
| fixed | this branch, both changesets consumed | the three affected suites | **exit 0**, 74 passed |
| fixed | this branch, both changesets consumed | `vitest run scripts/__tests__` — the validator's own command | **exit 0**, 164 files passed / 2 skipped, 4779 tests |

The defect leg is what makes the last row mean something: the same command on the same simulated tree fails before the change and passes after it.

## ⛔ Nothing was widened

`declaredEntries()` — the answer `ci.yml`'s fast path consumes, and the `--audit` census — reads only each ledger verdict's `reads` array. This change touches only `notRead` arrays, so that census cannot have moved by construction, and the scanner's own population is ledger-independent. On this branch: `auditTree` findings `[]`, `missingDocuments()` `[]`, and both suites are still candidates the scanner sees (via `.changeset/README.md` and `CHANGELOG.md` respectively), so neither becomes a `stale-test`. The gate's coordinate is untouched, per the constraint carried from objectui#9140.

## Gates

Every exit code landed to disk before it was read, never through a pipe.

| command | exit |
|:--|--:|
| `node scripts/check-changeset-presence.mjs` | 0 — *"no source or published contract of a released package changed in this range, so no changeset is owed"* |
| `pnpm check:changeset-claims` | 0 |
| `pnpm check:installed-pin-claims` | 0 |
| `pnpm check:control-bytes` | 0 |
| `pnpm check:new-line-citations` | 0 — 0 new citations |
| `pnpm check:test-path-roots` | 0 |
| `pnpm check:comment-mask-corpus` | 0 |
| `pnpm check:unreferenced-sources` | 0 |
| `pnpm type-check:scripts` | 0 |
| `pnpm lint:root` | 0 |
| `pnpm exec vitest run scripts/__tests__` | 0 |

`lint:root` is the lint lane that reaches `scripts/**`, and it ran over its **whole** population rather than a narrowed one: 364 files, the count read from eslint's own `--format json` output, 0 errors. The package lanes of `turbo run lint` are left to CI and this diff touches no file under `packages/`, `apps/` or `examples/`.

⛔ **No `skip-changeset` label**, although my dispatch asked for one. In this repository that label is a phantom: `scripts/__tests__/ci-cd-pipeline-doc.test.ts` pins that no workflow or gate under `.github/` or `scripts/` may mention it, and the changeset gate's own verdict line above is the authority that says nothing is owed here.

## Acceptance notes

Observations found alongside this work, **not** repaired here:

- `check-changeset-overwrite.test.ts` still writes two other fixture changesets, `.changeset/plum-pandas-wave.md` and `.changeset/6336-new-work.md`. Neither is a pending declaration today, so neither is this defect — but both carry the same latent shape, and that is precisely what the follow-up gate card (C, filed from this round per the ruling) exists to close once and for all rather than one filename at a time. Carrier: card C.
- `.changeset/olive-donkeys-smile.md` is itself pending under the generated `adjective-animal-verb` name that `.changeset/README.md` instructs authors to rename before committing. Noted, not filed — it is a queue-hygiene observation about one file, and nothing here depends on it. Carrier: whoever drains the release queue.
